query.description: A title word, a topic tag or a weekday, for example 'ai' or 'friday'. Returns course ids for spec_course_info and spec_course_enroll.

function.name: spec_course_info
function.description: Show the schedule, room, teacher and free seats of one course.

course_id.description: A course id from spec_course_find, for example 'sc-01'.

function.name: spec_course_enroll

course_id.description: A course id from spec_course_find, for example 'sc-02'.

student.description: Name of the student to enroll.

function.name: save_memory
function.description: Store one durable fact about the student for future conversations.

fact.description: One fact in one short sentence, for example 'enrolled in LLM Agents in September'.
